BattleCardAbility.Desc: [On Hit] Gain 1 Strength next Scene for every target hit
[On Use] Gain 2 Strength this Scene. If target is defeated or Staggered, use this page again on a random enemy
[On Clash Win] Return blocked damage to the attacker
[On Hit] Inflict 2 Burn next Scene. This die is rolled 4 times
[On Hit] Inflict 6 Erosion, 6 Feeble, 6 Bind and 6 Paralysis this Scene and next Scene
[On Hit] Boost next die's max value by +10
[On Hit] Inflict 5 Fragile this Scene and Boost next die's max value by +10
[On Hit] Boost last die's max value by +10; Deal 50% more damage against targets with 50% or less HP
[On Hit] 30% chance to inflict 1 Strong Seal
[On Play] Reduce all damage from enemies to 0. Reduce cost of all Pages by 1. Playable at Emotion Level 2 and above
[On Play] Gain Hax Armor next Scene. Playable at Emotion Level 3 and above
Dice on this page and the page clashing with it are unaffected by Power gain or loss. Playable at Emotion Level 4 and above
[On Hit] Enemies become Uncontrollable and attacks allies.
